input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: No non-solicit, no-hire or inducement covenant exists anywhere in this single-section agreement. Literal searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "engage", "personnel" and "non-compete", plus a regex search for "(shall|will) not (solicit|hire|employ|engage|induce)", return no restrictive covenant. The only employment-related provisions are the independent-contractor/no-agency clause quoted above (p0066), the mutual indemnities referencing third parties "hired by, employed, retained or under" a party's control (p0051-p0052), and the confidentiality clause permitting need-to-know disclosure to employees and directors (p0061); none restrict The Associated Press from soliciting or hiring Kubient personnel. This satisfies our preferred position of no non-solicit binding the Customer, so no redline is proposed and the document text is unchanged. The deterministic sub-checks for a general-solicitation carve-out and a duration of 12 months or less are inapplicable and non-probative here, because they presuppose an existing non-solicit; there is no covenant to which a carve-out or duration limit could attach. If Kubient later introduces a non-solicit, we would hold to the fallback (mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs) and reject any no-hire.
